Texte: [AbstractCapabilityInclude] Inclusion d'une Capability dans une autre (référence via 'included').
Anglais: Inclusion of a Capability in another one (reference via 'included').

Texte: [AbstractCapabilityRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre une Capability et une Capability/OperationalCapability de la couche supérieure qu'elle réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between a Capability and the upper-layer Capability/OperationalCapability it realizes.

Texte: [AbstractFunctionAbstractCapabilityInvolvement] Implication d'une Function dans une Capability (référence via 'involved').
Anglais: Involvement of a Function in a Capability (reference via 'involved').

Texte: [AbstractStateRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre un State/Mode et le State/Mode de la couche supérieure qu'il réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between a State/Mode and the upper-layer State/Mode it realizes.

Texte: [ActivityAllocation] Allocation d'une OperationalActivity vers un Role qui la réalise. Lié au concept de Role, exclu de l'API Python4Capella.
Anglais: Allocation of an OperationalActivity to a Role performing it. Related to the Role concept, excluded from the Python4Capella API.

Texte: [BooleanPropertyValue] Variante typée booléenne de PropertyValue. CONFIRME la limitation PV-001: le métamodèle technique réel utilise des types distincts par nature de valeur (BooleanPropertyValue, et probablement StringPropertyValue/IntegerPropertyValue/FloatPropertyValue/EnumerationPropertyValue non observés dans les échantillons), alors que Python4Capella les unifie sous un seul type PropertyValue.
Anglais: Boolean-typed variant of PropertyValue. CONFIRMS limitation PV-001: the actual technical metamodel uses distinct types per value kind (BooleanPropertyValue, and probably StringPropertyValue/IntegerPropertyValue/FloatPropertyValue/EnumerationPropertyValue not observed in the samples), whereas Python4Capella unifies them under a single PropertyValue type.

Texte: [Capability] The ability of the system to supply a service contributing to fulfilling one or more Missions. A Capability represents a system usage context. It is characterized by a set of Functional Chains and Scenarios it references.
[CapabilityExploitation] Lien entre une Capability et une autre Capability qu'elle exploite (référence via attribut 'capability').
Anglais: Link between a Capability and another Capability it exploits (reference via the 'capability' attribute).

Texte: [CapabilityInvolvement] Implication d'un Actor/Component dans une Capability qui l'exploite (référence via 'involved').
Anglais: Involvement of an Actor/Component in a Capability exploiting it (reference via 'involved').

Texte: [CapabilityRealization] The implementation of the system Capabilities in Logical Architecture and Physical Architecture
[CapabilityRealizationInvolvement] Implication d'un Component dans une CapabilityRealization (qui contribue à réaliser la capability).
Anglais: Involvement of a Component in a CapabilityRealization (contributing to realizing the capability).

Texte: [CatalogElement] Élément de catalogue REC/RPL générique (add-on Requirement/RE). Voir REC et RPL dans le document Python4Capella pour la sémantique métier équivalente.
Anglais: Generic REC/RPL catalog element (Requirement/RE add-on). See REC and RPL in the Python4Capella document for the equivalent business semantics.

Texte: [CatalogElementLink] Lien entre un REC (origin) et ses RPL (replicas), exprime la relation de réplication.
Anglais: Link between a REC (origin) and its RPLs (replicas), expressing the replication relationship.

Texte: [CatalogElementPkg] A package to structure the definition of REC / RPL elements
[ChangeEvent] An event defined by WHEN something occurs
[ChoicePseudoState] Pseudo-état de choix (branchement conditionnel) dans une StateMachine/Region.
Anglais: Choice pseudo-state (conditional branch) in a StateMachine/Region.

Texte: [Collection] Type de données représentant une collection (liste/ensemble) d'éléments d'un type donné. Equivalent Python4Capella: Collection (sous-type de DataType).
Anglais: Data type representing a collection (list/set) of elements of a given type. Python4Capella equivalent: Collection (DataType subtype).

Texte: [CombinedFragment] The identification of a specific operator (ALT, OPT, LOOP...) in the sequence of a scenario
[CommunicationMean] Describes the media between the Operational Entities / Actors to support the Operational Interactions
[CompliancyDefinition] The type of compliancy which have to be respected by the RPL regarding its REC definition. Default list of compliancies is:
[ComponentExchange] Represent the interactions between Logical / Behavioral Components. Exchanges connects Component Ports.
[ComponentExchangeAllocation] Allocation d'un ComponentExchange vers un élément de couche différente.
Anglais: Allocation of a ComponentExchange to an element of a different layer.

Texte: [ComponentExchangeFunctionalExchangeAllocation] A regroupement of FunctionalExchanges for graphical simplification of diagrams
[ComponentFunctionalAllocation] A regroupement of FunctionalExchanges for graphical simplification of diagrams
[ComponentPort] A port on a BehavioralComponent defining a logical interaction point
[ComponentPortAllocation] Allocation d'un ComponentPort vers un élément de couche différente.
Anglais: Allocation of a ComponentPort to an element of a different layer.

Texte: [ComponentRealization] Lien de traçabilité (sourceElement/targetElement) entre un Component et le Component de la couche supérieure qu'il réalise (ex: PhysicalComponent réalise LogicalComponent).
Anglais: Traceability link (sourceElement/targetElement) between a Component and the upper-layer Component it realizes (e.g. PhysicalComponent realizes LogicalComponent).

Texte: [ConceptPkg] Package contenant les Concepts (Operational Analysis), notion non documentée dans le Python4Capella Simplified Metamodel (absente du document source).
Anglais: Package containing Concepts (Operational Analysis), a notion not documented in the Python4Capella Simplified Metamodel (absent from the source document).

Texte: [ConfigurationItem] System part to be acquired or produced, in as many copies as the physical architecture requires
[Constraint] A generic constraint which can be defined on Capella elements

[ControlNode] Nœud de contrôle dans une FunctionalChain (AND/OR/ITERATE), pilote le flux de la chaîne. Exclu de l'API Python4Capella (mentionné explicitement comme exclusion dans le Foreword du document Python4Capella).
Anglais: Control node in a FunctionalChain (AND/OR/ITERATE), driving the chain flow. Excluded from the Python4Capella API (explicitly listed as an exclusion in the Foreword of the Python4Capella document).

Texte: [DeepHistoryPseudoState] Pseudo-état d'historique profond dans une StateMachine/Region.
Anglais: Deep history pseudo-state in a StateMachine/Region.

Texte: [EPBSArchitecture] The element containing all definitions from the End-Product Breakdown Structure.
[Entity] Entité au niveau Operational Analysis. Si actor='true', représente un OperationalActor.
Anglais: Entity at Operational Analysis level. If actor='true', represents an OperationalActor.

Texte: [EntityOperationalCapabilityInvolvement] Implication d'une Entity dans une OperationalCapability.
Anglais: Involvement of an Entity in an OperationalCapability.

Texte: [EntityPkg] A package to define Operational entities / actors
[EnumerationPropertyLiteral] A value defined in an EnumerationPropertyType
[EnumerationPropertyType] The definition of an Enumeration to type a PropertyValue
[EventReceiptOperation] Opération de réception d'un événement dans un Scenario.
Anglais: Event receipt operation in a Scenario.

Texte: [EventSentOperation] Opération d'émission d'un événement dans un Scenario (lié à un SequenceMessage).
Anglais: Event sending operation in a Scenario (linked to a SequenceMessage).

Texte: [ExchangeCategory] A regroupement of FunctionalExchanges for graphical simplification of diagrams

[ExchangeItem] Ordered set of references to elements carried together during an interaction or exchange between functions, components and actors. The elements are carried simultaneously, in the same conditions, with the same non-functional properties. The “elements” are called data
[ExchangeItemAllocation] The involvement of an ExchangeItem by an Interface.
[ExchangeItemElement] A part of the information contained by an ExchangeItem
[Execution] Période d'exécution d'une InstanceRole dans un Scenario (barre verticale du diagramme de séquence).
Anglais: Execution period of an InstanceRole in a Scenario (vertical bar of the sequence diagram).

Texte: [ExecutionEnd] Fragment marquant la fin d'une Execution dans un Scenario.
Anglais: Fragment marking the end of an Execution in a Scenario.

Texte: [ExecutionEvent] Événement déclenchant une Execution dans un Scenario.
Anglais: Event triggering an Execution in a Scenario.

Texte: [FragmentEnd] Extrémité d'un fragment combiné (CombinedFragment) dans un Scenario.
Anglais: End of a combined fragment (CombinedFragment) in a Scenario.

Texte: [FunctionInputPort] An FunctionInputPort defines what a Function is requiring
[FunctionOutputPort] A FunctionOutputPort defines what a Function is capable of producing
[FunctionRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre une Function et la Function de la couche supérieure qu'elle réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between a Function and the upper-layer Function it realizes.

Texte: [FunctionalChain] Describe the system behaviour in a particular usage context with references towards Functions and Functional Exchanges
[FunctionalChainAbstractCapabilityInvolvement] Implication d'une FunctionalChain dans une Capability.
Anglais: Involvement of a FunctionalChain in a Capability.

Texte: [FunctionalChainInvolvementFunction] Implication d'une Function dans une FunctionalChain (étape de la chaîne). Référence la Function via l'attribut 'involved'.
Anglais: Involvement of a Function in a FunctionalChain (chain step). References the Function via the 'involved' attribute.

Texte: [FunctionalChainInvolvementLink] Implication d'un FunctionalExchange dans une FunctionalChain, avec source/target précisant l'ordre topologique de parcours dans la chaîne.
Anglais: Involvement of a FunctionalExchange in a FunctionalChain, with source/target giving the topological traversal order in the chain.

Texte: [FunctionalChainRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre une FunctionalChain et la FunctionalChain/OperationalProcess de la couche supérieure qu'elle réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between a FunctionalChain and the upper-layer FunctionalChain/OperationalProcess it realizes.

Texte: [FunctionalChainReference] Référence à une FunctionalChain depuis l'intérieur d'une autre FunctionalChain (chaînes imbriquées).
Anglais: Reference to a FunctionalChain from inside another FunctionalChain (nested chains).

Texte: [FunctionalExchange] A functional exchange represents a dependency between a source function and a target one. Exchanges connect Function Ports, which specify what a Function is capable of producing or is requiring.
[FunctionalExchangeRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre un FunctionalExchange et celui de la couche supérieure qu'il réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between a FunctionalExchange and the upper-layer one it realizes.

Texte: [Generalization] Lien de généralisation/spécialisation (héritage) entre deux Class (sub/super).

[GenericTrace] Lien de traçabilité générique entre deux éléments quelconques, sans sémantique de réalisation inter-couches (contrairement à TransfoLink qui sert plutôt aux traces de transformation). Exclu de l'API Python4Capella ('Generic Traces' explicitement listées comme exclusion dans le Foreword).
Anglais: Generic traceability link between any two elements, without cross-layer realization semantics (unlike TransfoLink, which is rather used for transformation traces). Excluded from the Python4Capella API ('Generic Traces' explicitly listed as an exclusion in the Foreword).

Texte: [InformationRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre une Class/ExchangeItem et celle de la couche supérieure qu'elle réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between a Class/ExchangeItem and the upper-layer one it realizes.
Initial pseudo-state (entry point) of a Region.

Texte: [InstanceRole] The involvement of an element (function, system, component or actor) in a scenario
[InteractionOperand] Opérande d'un CombinedFragment (ex: branche d'un ALT) dans un Scenario.
Anglais: Operand of a CombinedFragment (e.g. branch of an ALT) in a Scenario.

Texte: [InteractionState] État/activité représenté dans un Scenario, lié à une Function ou un State (relatedAbstractFunction/relatedAbstractState).
Anglais: State/activity shown in a Scenario, linked to a Function or a State (relatedAbstractFunction/relatedAbstractState).

Texte: [InteractionUse] Référence à un autre Scenario inclus dans le Scenario courant.
Anglais: Reference to another Scenario included in the current Scenario.

Texte: [Interface] The definition of ExchangeItems which can be send / received by a ComponentPort
[KeyValue] Paire clé-valeur utilisée pour des métadonnées/extensions (ex: stockage de paramètres PVMT ou autres add-ons).
Anglais: Key-value pair used for metadata/extensions (e.g. storing PVMT parameters or other add-ons).

Texte: [LiteralBooleanValue] Valeur littérale booléenne (true/false) utilisée comme literal d'une Enumeration ou valeur par défaut d'une Property.
Anglais: Boolean literal value (true/false) used as an Enumeration literal or a Property default value.

Texte: [LogicalArchitecture] The element containing all definitions from the Logical Architecture.
[LogicalArchitectureRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre la PhysicalArchitecture et la LogicalArchitecture qu'elle réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between the PhysicalArchitecture and the LogicalArchitecture it realizes.

Texte: [LogicalComponent] Logical Components are the artefacts enabling a notional decomposition of the system as a "white box", independently from any technological solutions, but dealing with major system decomposition constraints
[LogicalComponentPkg] A package to contain the LogicalSystem, LogicalComponents and LogicalActors
[LogicalFunction] The definition of a Function in the Logical Architecture
[MessageEnd] Extrémité (début ou fin) d'un SequenceMessage dans un Scenario.
Anglais: End (start or finish) of a SequenceMessage in a Scenario.

Texte: [Mission] High-level goal to which the System should contribute. To be fulfilled, a Mission should use a number of system Functions regrouped within one or more Capabilities
[MissionInvolvement] Implication d'une Capability dans une Mission (référence via 'involved').
Anglais: Involvement of a Capability in a Mission (reference via 'involved').

Texte: [Mode] A Mode is a behavior expected from the system, an Actor or a component in chosen conditions
[ModelInformation] Métadonnées techniques du modèle (informations de version, d'origine).
Anglais: Technical metadata of the model (version and origin information).

Texte: [OpaqueExpression] Expression libre (texte) utilisée comme valeur calculée, typiquement pour exprimer une borne min/max non-littérale ou une condition.
Anglais: Free (text) expression used as a computed value, typically to express a non-literal min/max bound or a condition.

Texte: [OperationalActivity] Process step or action/operation/service performed by an Operational entity / actor and likely to influence the system definition or usage. Implementing operational activities generally produces elements of interactions expected by other activities
[OperationalAnalysis] The element containing all definitions from the Operational Analysis.
[OperationalAnalysisRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre la SystemAnalysis et l'OperationalAnalysis qu'elle réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between the SystemAnalysis and the OperationalAnalysis it realizes.

Texte: [OperationalCapability] An operational capability is an ability, expected of one or more operational entities / actors. An operational capability is characterized by a set of operational processes and scenarios
[OperationalProcess] An operational process is used to describe a particular context for performing operational activities to contribute to one or more operational capabilities

[Part] Instance/rôle d'un composant (Component) dans le contexte de son composant parent. Référence la définition réelle via l'attribut abstractType='#<id>'. C'est le mécanisme central de containment hiérarchique visible dans le Project Explorer Capella (voir section instantiation_pattern).
Anglais: Instance/role of a Component in the context of its parent component. References the actual definition via the abstractType='#<id>' attribute. This is the central hierarchical containment mechanism visible in the Capella Project Explorer (see instantiation_pattern section).

Texte: [PartDeploymentLink] Lien de déploiement: un Part (deployedElement) est déployé sur un autre Part (location). Utilisé pour le déploiement logiciel/matériel en Physical Architecture.
Anglais: Deployment link: a Part (deployedElement) is deployed on another Part (location). Used for software/hardware deployment in Physical Architecture.

Texte: [PhysicalArchitecture] The element containing all definitions from the Physical Architecture.
[PhysicalArchitectureRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre l'EPBSArchitecture et la PhysicalArchitecture qu'elle réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between the EPBSArchitecture and the PhysicalArchitecture it realizes.

Texte: [PhysicalArtifactRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre un ConfigurationItem (EPBS) et le PhysicalComponent (PA) qu'il réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between a ConfigurationItem (EPBS) and the PhysicalComponent (PA) it realizes.

Texte: [PhysicalComponent] A generic Physical Component which can be either a BehaviorPC or a NodePC
[PhysicalComponentPkg] A package to contain the PhysicalSystem, PhysicalComponents and PhysicalActors
[PhysicalFunction] The definition of a Function in the Physical Architecture
[PhysicalLink] Means of communication, transport or routing between two Node components, used as a support for behavioral exchanges
[PhysicalPath] Set of Physical Links defining a continuous path likely to route one or more behavioral exchanges
[PhysicalPathInvolvement] Implication d'un PhysicalLink dans un PhysicalPath, avec chaînage via nextInvolvements pour exprimer l'ordre topologique du chemin physique.
Anglais: Involvement of a PhysicalLink in a PhysicalPath, chained through nextInvolvements to express the topological order of the physical path.

Texte: [PhysicalPort] A port on a Node component defining a physical interaction point
[PortAllocation] The definition of ExchangeItems which can be send / received by a ComponentPort
[PortRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre un port (Function/Component) et celui de la couche supérieure qu'il réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between a port (Function/Component) and the upper-layer one it realizes.

Texte: [PropertyValueGroup] Regroupement de plusieurs PropertyValue sous un même groupe nommé (ex: regroupement par thème/add-on). Documenté dans le Word doc sous PropertyValueGroup.
Anglais: Grouping of several PropertyValues under the same named group (e.g. grouping by theme/add-on). Documented in the Word doc under PropertyValueGroup.

Texte: [PropertyValuePkg] Package conteneur de PropertyValue/PropertyValueGroup/EnumerationPropertyType, rattaché à un PropertyValuePkgContainer (ex: SystemEngineering, ou tout CapellaElement supportant les extensions).
Anglais: Container package for PropertyValue/PropertyValueGroup/EnumerationPropertyType, attached to a PropertyValuePkgContainer (e.g. SystemEngineering, or any CapellaElement supporting extensions).

Texte: [RecCatalog] The root package which contains the REC / RPL definitions
[Region] A region is an orthogonal part of either a composite state or a state machine.

[Role] Rôle opérationnel (ex: 'Common Role: Non functional constraints engineering'), assignable à des Entity/OperationalActivity. Exclu de l'API Python4Capella ('Roles in the Operational Analysis' explicitement listé comme exclusion dans le Foreword).
Anglais: Operational role (e.g. 'Common Role: Non functional constraints engineering'), assignable to Entity/OperationalActivity. Excluded from the Python4Capella API ('Roles in the Operational Analysis' explicitly listed as an exclusion in the Foreword).

Texte: [RoleAllocation] Allocation d'un Role vers l'Entity qui l'assume (sourceElement=Entity probable, targetElement=Role). Exclu de l'API Python4Capella.
Anglais: Allocation of a Role to the Entity assuming it (probably sourceElement=Entity, targetElement=Role). Excluded from the Python4Capella API.

Texte: [RolePkg] Package contenant les Roles de l'Operational Analysis. Exclu de l'API Python4Capella (mentionné explicitement: 'Roles in the Operational Analysis' sont exclus).
Anglais: Package containing the Roles of the Operational Analysis. Excluded from the Python4Capella API (explicitly mentioned: 'Roles in the Operational Analysis' are excluded).

Texte: [Scenario] A scenario of use of the system defined by a specific sequence
[ScenarioRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre un Scenario et celui de la couche supérieure qu'il réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between a Scenario and the upper-layer one it realizes.

Texte: [SequenceLink] Lien conditionnel entre deux ControlNodes dans une FunctionalChain. Exclu de l'API Python4Capella.
Anglais: Conditional link between two ControlNodes in a FunctionalChain. Excluded from the Python4Capella API.

Texte: [SequenceMessage] An exchange between InstanceRole performed in the frame of a scenario
[State] A State is a context undergone by the system, an actor or a component in specific circumstances (for example imposed by the environment)
[StateFragment] The call of a function or mode / state by an InstanceRole in the context of a scenario
[StateMachine] State Machine is a way to define some of the expected behavior of the System, a Component or an external Actor
[StateTransition] A possible transition between 2 modes or 2 states
[StateTransitionRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre une StateTransition et celle de la couche supérieure qu'elle réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between a StateTransition and the upper-layer one it realizes.

Texte: [SystemAnalysis] The element containing all definitions from the System Analysis.
[SystemAnalysisRealization] Lien de traçabilité entre la LogicalArchitecture et la SystemAnalysis qu'elle réalise.
Anglais: Traceability link between the LogicalArchitecture and the SystemAnalysis it realizes.

Texte: [SystemComponent] Composant au niveau System Analysis. Si l'attribut actor='true', représente un Actor du système (équivalent Python4Capella: SystemActor). Sans cet attribut sur l'élément racine du package, représente le System lui-même (équivalent Python4Capella: System).
Anglais: Component at System Analysis level. If the actor='true' attribute is set, represents a system Actor (Python4Capella equivalent: SystemActor). Without this attribute on the package root element, represents the System itself (Python4Capella equivalent: System).

Texte: [SystemComponentPkg] A package to contain the System and the Actors
[SystemEngineering] The main element in the definition of a Capella model. Contains the perspectives of the Arcadia methodology
[SystemFunction] The definition of a Function in the System Analysis
